india_trends.title: HEG receives NCLT approval for demerger scheme; shareholders to get 1:1 shares in HEG Graphite
india_trends.summary: HEG has received approval from the NCLT for its demerger plan, creating two independent companies. Shareholders will receive one HEG Graphite share for each HEG share. The restructuring aims to offer differentiated exposure to graphite electrodes and advanced materials, enhancing long-term value.
